title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 12. Notes that almost 60 % of the EIB’s financing in 2025 was directed towards the transition to a low-carbon economy; calls on the EIB to reinforce competitiveness and economic security by enabling a predictable, inclusive, fair and affordable transition, without placing an undue burden on industry and households; warns against the disproportionate allocation of EIB funds to climate-related objectives at the expense of traditional sectors of the economy; urges the EIB to put an immediate end to ideological ‘green conditionalities’ that restrict access to credit for European SMEs and agricultural businesses, and to rebalance its portfolio to prioritise the immediate survival of the European economy and the competitiveness and reindustrialisation of the Member States over excessively restrictive environmental requirements;
